description: Actual en::text::lcs against actual algorithm LCS APIs, a brute-force oracle, the shared catalogue rows and the histogram exclusion.
state: Enumerated byte fixtures, logging PartialEq probe, catalogue labels, library compare and assertions.
forward: Call actual public en and algorithm LCS APIs and compare lengths with an exhaustive subsequence oracle.
Bind the three shared-contract catalogue rows to declared inputs and actual output labels; check library finite equality.
inverse: Success retains all implementations satisfying these finite probes and the a-major comparison trace.
Failure may have source, catalogue, adapter or fixture explanations.
cost: Fixed enumeration: 3969 pairs with three library calls (en, classical, bit-parallel) and 14641 pairs with two (en, classical), each with an O(2^|a|) oracle, plus seven fixtures; catalogue reparsed per helper call.
limitations: Finite byte and small-char evidence; no universal source proof, timing claim or Unicode normalization coverage.
Allocation failure excluded; the histogram relation is a partial exclusion, not a catalogue complement.
